lines.text: Many learners say: I yesterday saw her.
Do not put yesterday between I and saw.
The second one! I saw her yesterday.

data.why: Do not put yesterday between I and saw.

native.tip: yesterday は主語と動詞の間に入れません。文の最後か最初に置きます。
native.caption: “I yesterday saw her.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語は「昨日」を動詞の前に置きますが、英語では主語と動詞の間には入れません。“I saw her yesterday.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“I saw her yesterday.” “I went to the park yesterday.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Do not put yesterday between I and the action word.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I yesterday saw her.” 😅 In Japanese the time word goes before the verb, but in English it does not go between I and the verb. The natural way is “I saw her yesterday.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
